items.title: 18.04 S18 Topic 4: Cauchy's integral formula
items.summary: Cauchy’s theorem is a big theorem which we will use almost daily from here on out. Right away it will reveal a number of interesting and useful properties of analytic functions. More will follow as the course progresses.
